output_list.description: The transfer function in the CryptoCoinRealWorld contract has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the input value is too large, it may cause the balance of the recipient address to exceed the maximum value that can be stored in a uint256 variable, leading to incorrect results and potentially unauthorized transfers.

The withdrawForeignTokens function in the CryptoCoinRealWorld contract also has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the input value is too large, it may cause the balance of the contract to exceed the maximum value that can be stored in a uint256 variable, leading to incorrect results and potentially unauthorized withdrawals.
